images.caption: Fig. 1. The TASR loop. The retriever ranks candidate paragraphs against the question once; each round reveals the next-ranked paragraph and calls the LLM. The raw answer is normalized to ˜ar and compared with the previous round’s ˜ar−1. The first answer- token logit margin mr is isotonically calibrated on the tune split (offline) and compared against 0.25. TASR fires when both checks pass; otherwise the loop continues until the 5-round budget is exhausted. §3.4 provides a worked example.

The margin is monotonically informative.
